description: Shared object definitions for bibliographic records. Field names and semantics deliberately mirror CSL-JSON so that records round-trip losslessly to CSL-JSON, and from there to BibTeX/biblatex, RIS, and any CSL style.

languageText.description: One language variant of bibliographic display text.

keywordConcept.description: One keyword concept with equal language variants.

contributor.description: One contributor to a work. Mirrors a CSL-JSON name object, plus atproto-native identity fields. Either the structured name fields or `literal` must be present, never both.

family.description: Equal language variants of the family name. For CJK names, the surname (e.g. 山田).

given.description: Equal language variants of the given name(s). For CJK names, the personal name (e.g. 太郎).

droppingParticle.description: Equal language variants of the particle dropped when the given name is omitted.

nonDroppingParticle.description: Equal language variants of the particle retained when the given name is omitted.

literal.description: Equal language variants of an unstructured name, for organisations or mononyms. Use INSTEAD OF family/given.

latinized.description: Romanised variants, for CJK authors cited in Latin script.

did.description: atproto DID of this contributor, when known. Lets an AppView link a citation to a live account.

orcid.description: Bare ORCID iD, e.g. '0000-0002-1825-0097'. No https://orcid.org/ prefix.

sequence.description: 1-based position within this role's list. Required for correct BibTeX output if a client reorders the array.

date.description: CSL-JSON-compatible date. Deliberately NOT an ISO datetime: bibliographic dates are routinely partial ('2019'), approximate ('ca. 1750'), ranged, or non-numeric ('in press').

literal.description: Non-numeric date rendered verbatim: 'in press', 'forthcoming', 'n.d.'. Set INSTEAD OF year.

identifier.description: Persistent identifier. DOI/arXiv/ISBN etc. have dedicated record fields; use this for the long tail.

scheme.description: 'ncid'/'naid' are CiNii identifiers, 'jglobal' is J-GLOBAL. Included because Japanese-language scholarship is poorly covered by DOI.

sourceInfo.description: Provenance of the metadata, so an AppView can distinguish curated records from bulk imports and refresh stale ones.

bibtexField.description: ESCAPE HATCH. A raw biblatex field/value pair with no CSL equivalent. Use sparingly: values here are opaque to every non-LaTeX consumer, and stored LaTeX escaping renders as garbage elsewhere. Frequent use means the schema is missing a field -- open an issue instead.
